---
name: Bug report
about: Something the plugin did wrong, or did not do
labels: bug
---

Leave out the text of your own map. A note, a state file or a saved ticket may hold names and other private matter, and a report does not need it: the command, what it printed and the shape of the map are enough. A security fault goes in a private report instead, as `SECURITY.md` says.

## What happened

What you typed or ran, what you expected, and what you got. Paste what the command printed, with any private path or name taken out.

## The release and the machine

The one line each of these prints:

```
context-central --version
claude --version
```

## What doctor says

```
context-central doctor
```

## The map, in outline

Its layout (`context-central where` says), whether it is kept in git, and whether the session was in a git work tree.
